issues.detail: The Hebrew place name is קָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ (Kadesh-barnea), but the Chinese renders it as '巴利珥曷的基列山' (the hill country of Gilead of Baal-peor?), which is a different location and not a translation of the Hebrew name.
The Chinese adds '基列山' (hill country of Gilead), which has no basis in the Hebrew text; the Hebrew only says 'from Kadesh-barnea'.
